sn35.127:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā piṇḍolabhāradvājo kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
sn35.127:1.2: atha kho rājā udeno yenāyasmā piṇḍolabhāradvājo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā piṇḍolabhāradvājena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.127:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā udeno āyasmantaṃ piṇḍolabhāradvājaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.127:1.4: ko nu kho bho bhāradvāja hetu ko paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susukāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu, yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañca āpādentīti?
sn35.127:1.5: vuttaṃ kho etaṃ mahārāja tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena
sn35.127:1.6: “etha tumhe bhikkhave mātumattisu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattisu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā”ti.
sn35.127:1.7: ayaṃ kho mahārāja hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susukāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:2.2: appekadā mātumattīsupi lobhadhammā uppajjanti bhaginimattīsupi lobhadhammā uppajjanti, dhītumattīsupi lobhadhammā uppajjanti.
sn35.127:2.3: atthi nu kho bho bhāradvāja añño ca hetu añño ca paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susukāḷakesā …pe… addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:3.1: vuttaṃ kho etaṃ mahārāja tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena
sn35.127:3.2: “etha tumhe bhikkhave imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhatha.
sn35.127:3.3: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttanti.
sn35.127:3.4: ayampi kho mahārāja hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susukāḷakesā …pe… brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:3.5: ye te bho bhāradvāja bhikkhū bhāvitakāyā bhāvitasīlā bhāvitacittā bhāvitapaññā tesaṃ taṃ na dukkaraṃ hoti.
sn35.127:3.6: ye ca kho te bho bhāradvāja bhikkhū abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā tesaṃ taṃ dukkaraṃ hoti.
sn35.127:3.7: appekadā bho bhāradvāja asubhato manasikarissāmāti subhato vā āgacchati.
sn35.127:3.8: atthi nu kho bho bhāradvāja añño ca hetu añño ca paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susukāḷakesā …pe… brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:4.1: vuttaṃ kho etaṃ mahārāja tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena
sn35.127:4.3: cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha, mānubyañjanaggāhino.
sn35.127:4.4: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha. rakkhatha cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatha.
sn35.127:4.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha, mānubyañjanaggāhino.
sn35.127:4.10: yatvādhikaraṇametaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha. rakkhatha manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjathā”ti.
sn35.127:4.11: ayampi kho mahārāja hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susu kāḷakesā …pe… brahmacariyaṃ caranti, addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:5.1: acchariyaṃ bho bhāradvāja, abbhutaṃ bho bhāradvāja.
sn35.127:5.2: yāva subhāsitaṃmidaṃ bho bhāradvāja tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena.
sn35.127:5.3: eso va kho bho bhāradvāja hetu esapaccayo yenime daharā bhikkhū susū kāḷakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā paṭhamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu yāvajīvaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caranti addhānañca āpādentīti.
sn35.127:5.4: ahampi kho bho bhāradvāja, yasmiṃ samaye arakkhiteneva kāyena ākekhitāya vācāya akekhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi antepuraṃ pavisāmi. ativiya maṃ tasmiṃ samaye lobhadhammā parisahanti.
sn35.127:5.5: yasmiñca khvāhaṃ bho bhāradvāja samaye rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi antepuraṃ pavisāmi na maṃ tattha tasmiṃ samaye lobhadhammā parisahanti.
sn35.127:5.6: abhikkantaṃ bho bhāradvāja, abhikkantaṃ bho bhāradvāja,
sn35.127:5.7: seyyathāpi bho bhāradvāja nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhotā bhāradvājena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn35.127:5.8: esāhaṃ bho bhāradvāja taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn35.127:5.9: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ bhāradvājo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
